summary: Ported the page header (icon-only profile/language/engine controls), the amber dirty badge, the header-anchored profile and language overlay panels with their square slot cards, in-place rename box and confirm banner, and the language rows. The language module entry moved from language/mod.rs to language.rs so the panel lives in the owned file; the per-language files stay under language/.
changed_files: src/ui2/language/mod.rs (deleted; its content moved into language.rs)

test_evidence.note: header.rs and profiles.rs are not registered in src/ui2/mod.rs yet, so the egui-ui suite was run twice: once with a temporary local registration of `pub mod header;`/`pub mod profiles;` (reverted before the commit, left to the integration step per the T4 convention), and once in a scratch mirror at %TEMP%/kilo/t6verify. The temporary-registration run is the in-tree evidence.
negative_controls: dirty badge guard removed -> the_dirty_badge_follows_the_draft fails
name box EditProfileName message removed -> the_rename_box_opens_and_commits_the_typed_name fails
panel anchor y offset set to 0 -> the_panel_is_anchored_below_the_header_and_inside_the_page_edge fails

compose_contract_for_t7: header::header(ui, state) -> Vec<Message> draws the header bar
header::dirty_badge(ui, state) draws the amber badge when the draft is dirty (the Iced app mounts it in the action bar)
profiles::profile_overlay(ui, state) -> Vec<Message> draws the backdrop and anchored panel when a dialog is open
profiles::focus_profile_name(ui) records the deferred focus request for Effect::FocusProfileName
language::language_rows(ui, state) -> Vec<Message> is the language panel body
integration_requirements: Register `pub mod header;` and `pub mod profiles;` in src/ui2/mod.rs (the T2-T4 precedent: 869a78a).
The language.rs move needs no registration change: `pub mod language;` now resolves to language.rs.
risks: Registration of header/profiles in src/ui2/mod.rs is outside this task's ownership; without it the modules do not compile in-tree. Verified by temporary local registration only, reverted before the commit.
No native visual pass: anchoring, tints, hover states and text metrics are pinned by shape/label assertions only (the verification.md 'Native visual checks' gap applies).

Drawn panel width is 388px (PROFILE_PANEL_WIDTH 384 + 2*(PANEL_PADDING 1 + 1px stroke)), not the Iced 386: egui's Frame adds the stroke around the content on top of the inner margin. T3/T4 accept the same stroke-expansion convention; if exact 386 is wanted, the call site must subtract the stroke width.

theme::SlotState (T2) and state::SlotState (T1) are distinct enums for one three-state contract; profiles.rs bridges them in `theme_slot_state`. A third consumer would add another bridge; consolidating is a Master-level decision.

The four page glyphs (Layers, Languages, Power, Close) are painted in header.rs because theme::Icon (T2) carries only the five action glyphs and this task owns no theme file; folding them into theme::Icon is the same pending wave as mapping.rs's private set.
Iced published card presses on press; egui reports clicks on release (the established ui2 translation, same as T3/T4). One press still yields one message per control.
The dirty badge is drawn by header.rs although the Iced action bar owns its position; T7 must mount it there.
Accessible names are invented English strings ('Profile slots', 'Language', 'Engine on/off', 'Profile slot N', 'Close') pending the accessible-name localization policy raised in T2's report.

Effect::FocusProfileName is executed through a deferred flag consumed on the frame the rename field mounts, because requesting focus for a widget that frame has not drawn leaves AccessKit with a dangling focus. T7 must call profiles::focus_profile_name(ui). Escape stays on the global key path (T7).

The name box hover is published as Message::NameHovered and painted from the state (one-frame lag, as in Iced); only the positive side is emitted per box and slot_list clears it, so card order cannot cancel a fresh hover.
